## What changes?

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked`
- [ ] Relevant Windows target check
- [ ] Manual testing, if keyboard capture or startup integration changed

## Platform impact

- [ ] Linux
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Shared code only

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation reflects user-facing changes.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths or unrelated generated files are included.
